hermodoors.configuration.ownerOnlyPasspo: Only the owner edits the passport
hermodoors.configuration.title: Hermodoors settings
message.hermodoors.busy: %s is already working on this door
message.hermodoors.not_owner: Only the person in charge (%s) may change this passport
message.hermodoors.unlocked: The seal gives. The door is free.
passport.hermodoors.title: PASSPORT
tip.hermodoors.clamps.diagram: Clamp diagram: %s of %s free. The circled one is next.
tip.hermodoors.clamps.lever: Click to strike when the rocking lever lines up with the chalk mark. A clean blow loosens it; a miss jams it tighter and the lever rocks faster.
tip.hermodoors.passport.difficulty: Category I is forgiving, III is for the stubborn.
tip.hermodoors.passport.stamp: Stamp here to approve the passport. The door is locked again and its procedure reset.
tip.hermodoors.power.alarm: АВАРИЯ: the panel tripped. Wait for it to settle, then start again.
tip.hermodoors.power.breaker: Breaker %s. Close it only once the breaker feeding it is closed, or the whole panel trips.
tip.hermodoors.power.knife: Main switch (ВВОД). Nothing on this panel can be closed without supply.
tip.hermodoors.power.schematic: Wiring diagram: supply on the left, each breaker wired to the one that feeds it. Some pencil lines have faded.
tip.hermodoors.pump.bleed: Bleed valve (СБРОС). Hold to let pressure off.
tip.hermodoors.pump.gauge: Manometer. Hold the needle between %s and %s kgf/cm² (the green band).
tip.hermodoors.pump.lever: Hand pump. Drag the handle down to pump, back up to refill. Short strokes add a little, full strokes a lot.
tip.hermodoors.pump.relay: Time relay. Runs while the pressure is in the band and slips back when it is not.
tip.hermodoors.pump.relief: Relief valve. Lifts above 14.5 kgf/cm² and dumps most of the pressure.
tip.hermodoors.stage.clamps: Step: free the seized wedge clamps. Strike each clamp lever as it lines up with the chalk mark.
tip.hermodoors.stage.power: Step: restore power. Close the main switch, then the breakers, each one only after the breaker that feeds it (trace the wiring diagram).
tip.hermodoors.stage.pump: Step: build hydraulic pressure. Work the hand pump and keep the needle in the green band until the time relay runs out.
tip.hermodoors.stage.wheel: Step: turn the handwheel to draw the bolts. Anticlockwise, smoothly.
tip.hermodoors.wheel.strain: Load. In the red, the wheel is about to slip.
tip.hermodoors.wheel.wheel: Grab the rim and circle anticlockwise. Ease off where it binds; force it and your grip slips.
tooltip.hermodoors.dzg: Civil-defence shelter door (ДЗГ). Swings out on its hinges.
tooltip.hermodoors.germozatvor: Metro tunnel gate (гермозатвор). Slides into the wall.
tooltip.hermodoors.passport_hint: Sneak + use with an empty hand: door passport
